<section class="branded-flow image-right top-fade">
<div class="container-fluid box-content">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-md-5 col-md-offset-1">
<h2 class="">Always Learning</h2><p class=""></p><p>With access to insights spanning Rakuten’s global memberships, <a href="/legal-notices/rakuten-marketing-data/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Rakuten Marketing Data</a> is comprised of rich transactional data combined with advertiser and publisher data from our partners. Our system is constantly learning, bringing your customers into sharper focus every minute.</p><p></p> </div>
<div class="img-wrapper text-right col-md-6">
<img alt="" class="attachment-full size-full" height="736" sizes="(max-width: 436px) 100vw, 436px" src="https://rakutenmarketing.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/iPhone-X-Mockup.png?fit=436%2C736" srcset="https://rakutenmarketing.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/iPhone-X-Mockup.png?w=436 436w, https://rakutenmarketing.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/iPhone-X-Mockup.png?w=178 178w" width="436"/> </div>
</div>

<section class="branded-flow image-left none-fade">
<div class="container-fluid box-content">
<div class="row">
<div class="img-wrapper col-md-6">
<img alt="" class="attachment-full size-full" height="587" sizes="(max-width: 700px) 100vw, 700px" src="https://rakutenmarketing.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/MacBook-Silver.png?fit=700%2C587" srcset="https://rakutenmarketing.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/MacBook-Silver.png?w=700 700w, https://rakutenmarketing.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/MacBook-Silver.png?w=300 300w" width="700"/> </div>
<div class="col-md-5 col-md-offset-right-1">
<h2 class="">Strategic Insights</h2><p class=""></p><p>Through comprehensive analysis of our <a href="/legal-notices/rakuten-marketing-data/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Data</a>, we build a keen understanding of consumers—who they are, what they value, where they’ve been and where they’re going. These consumer insights, combined with multi-channel attributed data, enable intelligent optimization across every strategic campaign for increased effectiveness and scale. These insights don’t just sit with us; we give our clients full visibility and access through our reporting platform.</p><p></p> </div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
